title: pointcloud.org dataset manifest
description: Canonical schema for manifests/<id>/manifest.yaml. This is the single source of truth for the manifest format -- scripts/validate-manifests.mjs validates every manifest against this file (via ajv) in CI. pointcloud.org's ingest backend mirrors this same shape internally, EXCEPT for the handful of fields resolved away before a manifest reaches it (metadata_links[].href's relative-path form, and derivative_processing.{dtm,dsm}.pdal_filters_file) -- see this schema's own descriptions on those fields. See README.md for a walkthrough of adding a new dataset.

schema_version.description: Manifest schema version. Always 1 today -- bumped only if a future change is backwards-incompatible enough to need one.

derivative_processing.description: Optional; only consulted when dataset.derivatives is true. Every field falls back to the engine's default when omitted.

assets.description: Hand-authored list of individual assets. Exactly one of assets/assets_dir/external_source must be given -- see this schema's root-level oneOf.

assets_dir.description: Alternative to assets for a large batch of files we already hold in our own bucket (see its href pattern below -- this is only supported for our own bucket, not a foreign one). Exactly one of assets/assets_dir/external_source must be given.

external_source.description: Alternative to assets/assets_dir: a pointer into someone else's already-cataloged STAC document. Exactly one of assets/assets_dir/external_source must be given.

id.description: Dataset id -- must match this manifest's directory name, manifests/<id>/.

summary.description: May contain Markdown -- rendered as sanitized HTML on the site. Plain text is valid Markdown too.

providers.description: At least one entry, each an organization that produced/hosts/licenses this dataset. At least one entry must have a contact (used for ingest-failure notification emails) -- enforced here via 'contains'.

temporal.description: When the data itself was acquired -- distinct from publication_date.

publication_date.description: ISO 8601 date or timestamp. When this dataset was published/released, as distinct from temporal (when the data was acquired).

overview_image.description: Same href convention as assets[].href -- our own bucket, a foreign s3:// bucket (falls back to default_endpoint), or a bare https:// URL.

href.description: An absolute https:// URL, OR a path relative to this manifest's own directory pointing at a file checked into the repo alongside manifest.yaml (e.g. "report.pdf"). Relative paths are resolved by the site build (copied into the site's own static output), never by the ingest backend.

metadata_links.description: Pointers to externally-hosted or locally-checked-in metadata about this dataset (flight reports, sensor/acquisition documentation, etc.). Purely informational -- never processed by any ingest stage.

default_endpoint.description: Fallback S3 API endpoint for every asset href in this manifest that doesn't set its own `endpoint` -- lets a dataset declare, once, which S3-compatible service+account hosts its data: a real AWS S3 bucket in the default region needs no endpoint at all; anything else (this project's own bucket, someone else's S3-compatible bucket, or an AWS bucket outside the default region, e.g. USGS 3DEP EPT data in us-west-2) should set one, e.g. "https://<account_id>.example-s3-service.com" or "https://s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com". For "s3://pointcloud/..." hrefs (this project's own bucket) it's purely informational/explicit -- those are always fetched directly by pointcloud.org's own infrastructure, never over a public HTTP endpoint, so the value has no effect on how that data is actually retrieved.

contact.description: The person who can actually update this dataset's manifest/URLs on this organization's behalf, if any -- gets emailed if ingest preflight fails.

href.description: "s3://pointcloud/..." (our own bucket), "s3://<other-bucket>/..." (foreign bucket, resolved via endpoint/default_endpoint), a bare https:// URL, or a GDAL VSI path (/vsicurl/, /vsis3/, etc.).

endpoint.description: S3 API endpoint for this asset's href, e.g. "https://<account_id>.example-s3-service.com" (a non-AWS S3-compatible service) or "https://s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com" (AWS outside the default region). Falls back to dataset.default_endpoint if omitted. Set it explicitly for any bucket that isn't a real AWS S3 bucket in the default region -- including this project's own bucket, where it's purely informational (that data is always fetched directly by pointcloud.org's own infrastructure, never over a public HTTP endpoint, so this value has no effect on retrieval, only on which service the manifest documents as the host).

href.description: Only supported for our own bucket -- must be an "s3://pointcloud/..." prefix, since this is listed directly by pointcloud.org's own infrastructure.

pattern.description: Single leading "*" wildcard (suffix match), not a full glob. Defaults to "*.copc.laz".

endpoint.description: Same meaning as an individual asset's endpoint -- documents which S3-compatible service+account hosts this href. assets_dir is only supported for our own bucket today (href must be an s3://pointcloud/... prefix, listed directly by pointcloud.org's own infrastructure), so this is purely informational; falls back to dataset.default_endpoint if omitted.

href.description: URL to a STAC ItemCollection, Catalog, or Collection JSON document.

expand.description: true: href's Items/child-Collections each become their own pointcloud.org dataset (dry-run only as of 2026-08-01, see externalCatalog.ts). false/omitted: href itself is a single Collection to mirror as this one dataset.

resolution.description: GSD in meters for all derivative rasters. Falls back to each asset's copc.resolution when omitted.

pdal_filters.description: Inline filter stages. Mutually exclusive with pdal_filters_file. Replaces the engine's default pipeline entirely when given -- no 'append to defaults' mode.

pdal_filters_file.description: Path, relative to this manifest's own directory, to a JSON file containing just the filter-stages array (same shape as pdal_filters, no reader/writer -- the engine picks the reader from the source file type and appends its own writers.gdal stage). Mutually exclusive with pdal_filters. Resolved (read + parsed + inlined as pdal_filters) by build-datasets-payload.mjs before the manifest ever reaches the ingest backend.

pdalFilterStage.description: {"type": "filters.range", ...} etc, as PDAL itself expects. Not validated further -- passed through to the Container verbatim.
